description: Angular component for uploading trace files with drag-and-drop, listing uploaded files, and controlling trace upload actions.

classes.name: UploadTracesComponent
classes.description: Angular component allowing users to upload trace files with drag-and-drop, progress indication, and trace management.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and clears existing trace pipeline data.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Updates the progress UI during trace upload operations.

methods.name: onOperationFinished
methods.description: Resets progress state after upload completes or is canceled.

methods.name: onInputFiles
methods.description: Handles file selection from file input and emits the files for processing.

methods.name: onViewTracesButtonClick
methods.description: Emits an event to trigger viewing the list of uploaded traces.

methods.name: onClearButtonClick
methods.description: Clears the loaded trace list and resets the UI.

methods.name: onFileDragIn
methods.description: Handles drag over event to prevent default behavior during drag-and-drop.

methods.name: onFileDragOut
methods.description: Handles drag leave event to reset UI state during drag-and-drop.

methods.name: onHandleFileDrop
methods.description: Handles files dropped into the drop zone and emits them for upload.

methods.name: onRemoveTrace
methods.description: Removes a specific trace from the pipeline when user clicks remove button.

methods.name: getInputFiles
methods.description: Extracts File objects from input event for further processing.

ctags.name: files
ctags.pattern: /^    const files: FileList | null = (event?.target as HTMLInputElement)?.files;$/
